text:
leo: Quick idea: a compact 'scope grant' flow for sales demos that can also be used by delegated admins. goal: reduce friction when enabling a tenant for dedicated routes.

anya: Love this. Two modes: temporary token (30d) vs permanent binding. Temporary is safer for demos.

devon: API constraints: our routing layer needs a stable principal->route mapping. temporary tokens won't work for long-lived routing optimizations (cache warms, affinity). we need persisted binding for anything >24h.

maria: UX: show an "impact card" per route: estimated p95 latency, expected monthly token burn, and current quota consumption. make presets collapsible.

sec: Security checklist: every grant must emit an immutable audit event + human readable justification. tie to SSO identity (not email aliases). require approval for cross-tenant grants.

ops-bot: Note: rate-limit policy will default to tenant-level cap if no per-route quota is set.

leo: Proposal: modal steps -> 1) choose principals (team/service) 2) choose routes (searchable list) 3) pick granting mode (temporary 7/30d OR bind) 4) preview & confirm.

devon: API sketch: POST /admin/grants with body fields: tenant, principal, routes[], mode={temp|bind}, ttl_seconds, dry_run. returns preview: {affected_routes, estimated_cost, conflicts}.

anya: Preview should highlight conflicts like "route not allowed by org policy" or "requires billing-admin" with inline links to policy docs.

maria: Also include a tiny telemetry toggle in preview: "collect metrics for this grant (on/off)" for debugging only. default on for GA.

sec: For prod: require 2FA for org_admin confirms, and if grant is cross-tenant, it must go through approval queue. Also forbid granting wildcard routes (e.g., "/v1/*").

leo: rollout plan: alpha (internal) -> pilot with 5 customers -> feature flag at org level. telemetry events: grant_modal_open, grant_preview_view, grant_apply_success, grant_apply_failure. include tags: mode, principal_type, has_conflicts.

devon: Implementation note: binding creation will update the routing cache. we'll need a small window where old and new bindings coexist; plan a short stream-based invalidation.

anya: UX nit: show a small "why we ask for justification" hint. copy: "Helps audit trails and faster support. Visible to admins only"

ops-bot: Reminder: quota-engine will reject per-route quotas that exceed tenant budget cap. Provide clear error message like "Requested quota exceeds tenant budget (max 5M tokens/mo)".

maria: I'll mock the modal screens and the compact impact card. can we add a tiny "revert" action available for 48h after binding creation?

sec: Revert is OK but must still produce audit entries and not remove historical logs.

leo: Action items: devon to open API RFC for /admin/grants (+dry_run), maria/anya to provide mocks and copy, sec to document approval matrix, ops to test routing cache invalidation plan. we'll sync next Tue. 

sec: FYI I've filed SEC-452 for approval matrix.

devon: created RFC-998 and will ping for reviews.

leo: thanks all :thumbsup:
